summary: Completed comprehensive testing of ShriRamya e-commerce app. Backend (32/32 tests passed) and Frontend (all features working). Libas-style filtering system fully functional with URL sync, filter chips, and mobile drawer.
critical_code_review_comments: All APIs use MOCK data layer - no real database integration
Product images are real model images from Unsplash/Pexels as required
FilterSidebar has duplicate SortDropdown on mobile (one in header, one in grid area) - minor UX consideration
